form.title: Clean Vehicle Credits
form.notes: refundable: false for the personal-use parts. Line 13 (new clean vehicle, personal use) goes to Schedule 3 line 6f and line 18 (previously owned clean vehicle) goes to Schedule 3 line 6m, both nonrefundable and both limited by Form 1040 line 18 less other personal credits (lines 12 and 17). The business/investment parts are general business credits: line 8 goes to Form 3800 Part III line 1y and line 21 (commercial clean vehicles) to Form 3800 Part III line 1aa. TERMINATION, VERIFIED: the Instructions for Form 8936 (2025) state verbatim 'Clean vehicles acquired after September 30, 2025. Taxpayers cannot claim clean vehicle credits for new, previously owned, or commercial clean vehicles that they acquired after September 30, 2025.' and define acquisition: 'a vehicle is "acquired" as of the date a written binding contract is entered into and a payment has been made.' The terminating statute is P.L. 119-21, sections 30D, 25E and 45W. So tax year 2025 is a SPLIT year: a vehicle acquired 1 January to 30 September 2025 qualifies, one acquired 1 October to 31 December 2025 does not, and the test is the acquisition date rather than the placed-in-service date. MAGI limits from the form's own face, tested against the LOWER of the 2024 and 2025 figures: new and commercial $150,000 single/MFS, $225,000 head of household, $300,000 married filing jointly/qualifying surviving spouse; previously owned $75,000 / $112,500 / $150,000. Printed revision: Form 8936 (2025), Created 3/19/25.
